subject: [PATCH v4 8/8] mm/mempolicy: read the zoneref slot once in mempolicy_slab_node()

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the mempolicy_slab_node() function by reading the zoneref slot only once, instead of twice as previously done for bind or preferred-many policies. This change prevents a kernel NULL pointer dereference bug that occurs when a movable block in the zonelist goes offline while a task is holding a slab_strict_numa allocation. The patch fixes this issue by storing the zone reference in a variable and reusing it to look up the node, thus avoiding the second read of the slot.
